conditions: Browser or Node 20+ with fetch, FormData, Blob, AbortController, streams and Web Crypto SHA-256; ordinary immutable input records and native File/Blob objects
Self-hosted MiniMax-H3 ref2va API with documented /v1/system and /v1/jobs routes, Bearer authentication, allowlisted CORS and stable instance binding supplied by the UI
HTTPS service URL, or explicit localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] HTTP for development; no credentials, query or fragment in the configured URL
Provider reports, declared transport provenance, accepted submissions and matching artifact hashes do not independently verify live GPU execution or media semantics
Compatible GET /v1/capabilities schema 1 reports ref2va/bf16 and configured trusted options; no capability record grants authority to load an arbitrary adapter or change precision
Capability identity is required and must equal the parallel system observation; quantization must explicitly be false
observations: Multipart submission preserves reference order and separates server acceptance from model readiness and generation completion
Unknown POST outcomes retain uncertainty and idempotency identity; the module never automatically repeats a POST
Cancellation returns the server's actual state, including cancel_requested or an already succeeded task
Artifact transfer constructs only authenticated same-base routes, verifies byte length and SHA-256, and returns caller-owned Blob data
Bounded Range concurrency retries only failed GET ranges; a server ignoring the initial Range receives one full-file download
Requests are bounded by deadlines and AbortSignal; diagnostics omit multipart payloads and redact registered credentials
Capability discovery preserves configured versus ready: model download does not block admitted queue submissions
Explicit per-task attention_backend, acceleration_lora and steps; Turbo requires 5 schedule points / 4 model evaluations with no implicit step edit
Requested execution options and effective GPU-applied receipt remain separate facts
limits: No GPU start/stop, scheduler ownership, polling loop, persistent storage, object URL ownership, media decode validation or task list endpoint
Local validation covers parameter and file metadata limits; actual codecs, duration, frame rate, image dimensions and audio channels remain server checks
An upload timeout or abort can occur after server acceptance; without a server-supplied task ID the current API has no read-only idempotency-key lookup
Server instance binding and changed credential/address decisions belong to the caller; the transport does not infer continuity
Default verified artifact limit is 256 MiB (configurable up to 512 MiB), and assembling and hashing a Blob requires additional browser memory
Byte integrity against the server manifest does not prove video decodability, requested content, provenance or A100 BF16 inference
Local synthetic fixtures do not establish public-tunnel CORS, network reliability, GPU performance or full F/C/H/Q admission
question: 哪些事实已由传输回执与产物校验建立，哪些任务状态仍需服务器查询？

stateModel.budget: Per JSON response 1 MiB; upload metadata 12 files / 64 MiB; default 30 s request and 120 s upload deadlines; default 3 concurrent 1 MiB ranges and at most 2 retries per failed range; default 256 MiB artifact; no polling or growing task collection in this module

counterexamples: A successful 202 response while model_ready=false establishes queued acceptance, not GPU readiness
A lost POST acknowledgement may hide an accepted job; retrying with a new key may create duplicate work
cancel_requested and a lost cancel acknowledgement do not establish task cancellation
A provider-supplied external file URL is not authority to send the API credential to another host
An intact download matching a provider manifest is not evidence of decoded video content or live model execution
A configured but not yet ready Turbo adapter permits queuing; ready false does not mean unsupported
Capability discovery failure blocks new uploads, not authorized observation, cancellation or download of existing jobs
Choosing Turbo at 50 steps does not authorize silently changing to five steps
extensionSeam: Inject fetch and Web Crypto implementations; retain bounded transfer, credential isolation, exact job identity and unknown-outcome semantics when extending the server protocol

proofObligations.statement: 提交、查询、取消与下载分别报告已观察的服务事实；网络失败不能伪造任务终态
局部传输及哈希校验不推出GPU准备、媒体内容正确、云资源释放或完整目标达成

observations: Synthetic host exercises ordered upload, queued/running observations, cancellation state and byte-verified transfer without real network or GPU
assumptions: Backend contract and CORS configuration match this module
Caller pins task identity to the original API address and instance
